newsitem.title: USA: Maytag Q1 hurt by refrigerator costs.
newsitem.headline: Maytag Q1 hurt by refrigerator costs.

text.p: Maytag Corp said Thursday income for the first quarter, which was about flat with year-ago operating results, was trimmed by $10 million in costs for the introduction of its redesigned line of top-mount refrigerators.
The company said earnings were in line with expectations.

Maytag said its consolidated sales in the first quarter increased to $792.5 million and included $35.5 million in sales from the China joint venture formed last fall. Sales were $731.2 million in last year's first period.
Net income was $38.5 million or $0.39 cents a share, compared with last year's $40.5 million or $0.38 before a restructuring charge of $24.4 million or $0.23 a share.
Shares outstanding dropped to 97.6 million from 105.5 million a year ago. The first quarter interest expense rose to $14.7 million from $10.9 million.

"Performance in the first quarter went according to plan; there were no surprises," Maytag Chairman Leonard Hadley said in a statement. "Our sales strength came from Hoover floor care products, vending machines, Maytag laundry equipment in North America, export sales and RSD brand washers in China."
Hadley said refrigerator sales were off in the first two months of the year as old top-mount models were phased out and distribution of the new line began.

"Looking ahead, we continue to believe this will be another good year for Maytag," Hadley said. "New products and models will contribute to sales as we move through the year and introductory costs associated with our various new product initiatives will diminish."

Maytag said its North American home appliance sales were $701.2 million and operating income of $73.5 million. A year ago, sales were $682.7 million and operating income, excluding the restructuring charge, was $78.7 million.
Dixie-Narco's vending equipment sales rose to $55.9 million, versus $48.6 million a year ago. Operating income was $6.6 million, compared to $5.9 million.
Maytag makes major home appliances, floor care products and vending equipment.
